items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, or advertising. Official Woot documentation establishes access mechanics only; current public terms do not establish commercial/public rights. Keep private and preview-only; keep outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Parked-site decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. Ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement-boundary, rollback, and explicit-blocker evidence remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach one dated readiness packet per property by 2026-09-30T17:00Z.

Continue only existing measurement and repair-or-close work. Do not infer ROI, causal lift, or site attribution from aggregate Amazon data; do not create duplicate tasks or request duplicate telemetry. Close or evidence the existing repair item with validation, rollback, release/security, attribution, and measurement boundaries.

Maintain public-launch and security-sensitive-release gates. Fleet security evidence remains incomplete: fleet-doctor and operations sweeps have no results, and access, secrets, isolation, release, dependency, data-exposure, monitoring, incident, and disclosure controls are unevidenced. Continue the existing read-only evidence matrix only.

Preserve the 2026-09-21 Amazon result as aggregate and unattributed: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission. Matching-period costs, margin, ROI, payback, forecasts, and causal lift remain unknown; authorize no spend or monetization expansion.
